description: WRITE: Create a hosted checkout / payment link for a store + variant. Returns the created checkout including its `url` (the shareable payment link). API: POST /checkouts.

checkout_data.description: JSON:API checkout_data object (email, name, custom, discount_code, etc.).

checkout_options.description: JSON:API checkout_options object (embed, media, button_color, etc.).

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the checkout link expires.

product_options.description: JSON:API product_options object (name, description, redirect_url, etc.).

name: lemonsqueezy_create_checkout
title: Create checkout
